name: Admin Sales List — filters, search, date sections

planSteps.description: Enter phone number 923001234567 and click Send Code
Click the Sales tab in the bottom navigation
The Sales page loads showing a summary strip with total sales and gross profit, search bar, tab filters (All, Credit, Paid), and date filter chips (Today, Yesterday, This Week, This Month, Custom)
Only credit sales are shown in the list, each displaying customer name, date, Sold by employee name, Credit tag, and amount
Type a customer name in the search bar
The sales list filters to show only matching sales
Clear the search and click on a sale card
The sale detail page opens with customer info, items sold, payment summary, and note field
